# Cantrip collation data

This crate contains baked Rust data generated by the official `icu4x-datagen`
2.1.1 tool, using ICU `release-78.2`, CLDR JSON `48.0.0`, full locales and
`--collation-root-han unihan`. The seven collation markers are generated together
so tailoring indexes and root weights remain consistent. Only Rust source is
used by the server; it does not download data or run a helper process.

Install the generator and regenerate from the repository root:

```sh
cargo install icu4x-datagen --version 2.1.1 --locked --no-default-features \
  --features networking,baked_exporter,provider,rayon
node scripts/server-rust/regenerate-collation-data.mjs
```

The script accepts `--generator /absolute/path/to/icu4x-datagen` for a separately
installed tool. `generated-sha256.json` records the emitted files; include order
and provider call order in `mod.rs` are canonicalized because the exporter
iterates a marker set.

The Unihan table is required for Node compatibility. The smaller implicit-Han
table in the ordinary `icu_collator_data` crate gives different metadata hashes.
The full source/table license is retained in `LICENSE` and must accompany
distributed server artifacts. Regeneration requires the native Node comparison
tests before accepting changed data.

Sources:

- https://github.com/unicode-org/icu/releases/tag/release-78.2
- https://github.com/unicode-org/cldr-json/releases/tag/48.0.0
- https://docs.rs/crate/icu4x-datagen/2.1.1
- https://github.com/unicode-org/icu/blob/release-78.2/docs/userguide/icu_data/buildtool.md
